mainEntity.name: How do I compress a PDF to under 2 MB?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose Target size and enter 2. The tool tries different quality levels and keeps the best one that fits.

mainEntity.name: Will the text still be selectable?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Light mode, yes. In the stronger modes, pages become images, so text can be read but not selected or searched.
No. The PDF is compressed in your browser and never leaves your device.

mainEntity.name: Why did my PDF hardly get smaller?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDFs made of text and vector graphics are already compact. Big savings come from scans and photos.

mainEntity.name: Can I compress a password-protected PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not yet. Unlock it first, then compress it.
